steps.en: Two different addresses for one record are recognised as a duplicate
steps.id: Dua alamat berbeda untuk satu record dikenali sebagai duplicate

steps.en: The address with the newest update date is chosen
steps.id: Alamat dengan tanggal update terbaru dipilih

steps.en: The notice address is updated to the chosen address
steps.id: Alamat di notice diperbarui ke alamat terpilih
steps.why_en: Only rows inside one file are compared; a later file with an older date would still overwrite the saved address.
steps.why_id: Hanya baris dalam satu file yang dibandingkan; file berikutnya dengan tanggal lebih lama tetap menimpa alamat tersimpan.

steps.en: The letter goes to the latest updated address
steps.id: Surat dikirim ke alamat yang terakhir diperbarui

steps.en: For foreigners, the newest of several returned addresses is used
steps.id: Untuk warga asing, alamat terbaru dari beberapa alamat dipakai
steps.why_en: Dates are compared for one pass type only, and the daily job is switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Tanggal hanya dibandingkan untuk satu jenis pass, dan job hariannya dimatikan di setting production.
